preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The capital city s must be a valid city number within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui and 1 <= wi <= 1000 for vi, ui, wi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two different valid cities and have a positive length.
The distance l from the capital to the missile silos must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of Super Duper Secret Missile Silos located in Berland.
